text:
diego_r: hey team — diego here, day 1. I can log into Console but the Admin panel (Flags + Rollouts) shows "insufficient permissions". who is the fastest contact to get staging flag/operator access?

noelle: welcome Diego :wave: I'm your onboarding buddy — hi! For staging the fastest route is identity team add to the Okta group `redwood-console-devops-operators`. You can open the access form but I can also ping identity to do a manual add if you want speed.

diego_r: thanks Noelle — please ping them. I filed the form but it's stuck on "pending". email: diego@redwood.com.

indra: tagging from identity — hi @diego_r, we see the request ACC-8123. Manual adds are allowed for staging roles; prod needs security review + privacy sign-off. We'll do a manual add now. Quick note: we default staging operator grants to 3 days; if you need longer ask in the form and include a short justification.

id-bot: Access request ACC-8123 status: manual_provisioning_in_progress. Approvers: manager required. ETA manual grant ~8 minutes.

noelle: also FYI: if you need to run the feature-flag CLI locally, ask for a scoped SA and we'll drop the key into Vault under `secret/onboarding/sa/diego-ffcli`. Use tag `ffcli-temp` so infra knows it's short-lived.

diego_r: yes I need that for local e2e. do I request SA in the same form or separate?

indra: separate SA request is preferred. Use resource: "ServiceAccount (ffcli)" -> tag `e2e-staging`. No KMS unless you need to access encrypted secrets; KMS for prod requires two approvers.

buddy-bot: onboarding checklist updated: Console access step marked as in-progress for diego_r. Reminder: enable MFA before infra grants are approved.

diego_r: MFA is enabled. any chance the group add is immediate or do I need to logout/login?

noelle: usually immediate after Okta-sync, but the Console caches tokens. If you still see 403 do a full logout + clear site data or run `okta tool refresh-token`. CLI tokens also need a refresh: `ffctl auth login` after group add.

indra: manual add completed by indra. Group: `redwood-console-devops-operators`.

id-bot: Provision completed for ACC-8123. Temporary role duration: 3 days.

diego_r: confirmed — I can see Flags and Rollouts now. one more: any recommended minimal scopes for the SA? I only need to toggle flags and list rollouts.

noelle: scope: `flags.read`, `flags.toggle`, `rollouts.view`. That's the minimal set. If your CI needs to start rollouts add `rollouts.start` and include the CI job name in the request.

indra: once you have the SA key, please don't post it in public channels. We'll put it into Vault and give you a read lease for 7 days. Use `vault read -field=value secret/onboarding/sa/diego-ffcli > /tmp/sa.json` and then `ffctl auth login --service-account=/tmp/sa.json`.

diego_r: perfect — thanks y'all. I'll add a tiny note to onboarding docs about the Okta sync TTL and the SA flow (PR to docs coming).

noelle: welcome aboard again! ping me if you want a quick walkthrough of rollout strategies later. :smile:
